project_type: Next.js 16.2.10 App Router (React 19, TypeScript 5, Tailwind CSS 4)
build_system: npm with next build. No CI. Vitest for tests.
test_framework: vitest with node environment, path aliases configured (@/ -> src/). Tests at src/**/*.{test,property.test}.{ts,tsx}. 6 test files, 85 tests passing.
build_command: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. npx tsc --noEmit (0 errors). 2. npm run lint (no errors). 3. npm run build (succeeds). 4. npm test (85+ tests pass).
setup_instructions: npm install && npx prisma generate && delete .next folder if stale
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. No Docker needed. All user data in localStorage. Supabase DB exists but NOT wired to app. pdf-parse only for CLI scripts.
contribution_requirements: Feature-based folders (src/features/{name}/). No cross-feature imports (extract to src/shared/). Lazy-load Recharts with dynamic(() => import(...), { ssr: false }). NEVER use useSyncExternalStore for one-time localStorage reads (use useState(() => ...) lazy initializer). NEVER call router.push() during render. Mobile responsive. Dark mode compatible via CSS variables.
key_patterns: localStorage read pattern: if (typeof window === 'undefined') return default; try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) ?? 'default'); } catch { return default; }. Feature structure: components/, types/, utils/, hooks/. Navigation: src/shared/config/navigation.ts (add new items here). Routes: src/app/(protected)/{name}/page.tsx. CFA subjects ordered via sortByCfaOrder from src/shared/config/subjects.ts. SM-2 algorithm in flashcards/utils/sm2.ts. Sessions in cfa-buddy-sessions localStorage key. Questions loaded via question-loader.ts (sampleQuestions + imported from localStorage). Recharts lazy-loaded via next/dynamic. CSS variables for theming (var(--background), var(--foreground), var(--card-bg), var(--card-border), var(--accent-primary), var(--accent-secondary), var(--nav-hover-bg)).
directory_structure: src/app/(protected)/ = routes with sidebar layout. src/features/ = 19 feature modules. src/shared/ = cross-cutting code (components/layout, config, hooks, lib). Each feature has: components/, types/, utils/, hooks/ subdirs as needed.
